main_text.p: co'textu tot lectionum varietates, quare in data aliqua hypothesi translationis ab originario variantis, non poterit textus originarius esse corruptus sive aliter scriptus quàm autores scripserint. Non sufficit ad corrigendam versionem, solus ab originario dissensus.

Grammaticas R. R. Jonæ & Jehudæ non habemus, nec usquam illos vidi, sicut nec Aben Esdræ שפה ברורה aut ירוד מורא habemus libros צחות & מדקדקי לשון הקדש Ephodæi Grammaticam similiter non habemus, sed habemus alios plurimos. Liber שת ירות est in quarto, semel complicatus, crassitiei duorum digitorum, aut paulo minus, sed charactere exili, Venetiis anno 1618. cuius. In duas partes divisus est יד חעני ניד המלך & unaquæque pars sive manus continet quinque digitos 8. Libros. Primo digito nomen fecit אור הור שהוא חגדה התורה hoc autem fecit magna cum diligentia. page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words were copied from the scan with low certainty because the print is small and blurred. Hebrew fragments marked here were not read letter by letter: שפה ברורה, ירוד מורא, צחות, מדקדקי לשון הקדש, שת ירות, יד חעני ניד המלך, and אור שהוא חגדה התורה. Their vowel points and exact letters should be checked against the original. Printed "8." after "digitos" and the form "Libros." are kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
